note: Invented mails for the stub pack, keyed by the mail names of data/tables/laptop.json. Each mail is its subject followed by its body rows and must have exactly the mail's length in rows. Compiled by pnpm stubs into binarydata/email.edt (320-unit rows at each mail's offset; other rows stay empty). Original writing for ja2-node.

IMP_EMAIL_INTRO: Not every soldier has to come from a catalogue.
Our personality profiling site turns you into a field-ready recruit.
Answer a set of questions about how you think and how you fight.
We measure your strengths and your weaknesses honestly.
Then we write up a profile your team can rely on.
The service is quick, private and paid once.
Bring patience and a sense of humour.
Visit the profiling site from your laptop bookmarks.
MERC_INTRO: Our agency opens its doors to new clients this week.
We offer soldiers on daily contracts and fair prices.
Pay as you go, settle your account, keep your people happy.
OLD_ENRICO_1: You have heard the rumours. The country needs outside help, and the money is real.
Hire a team, land them in the north and start taking the land back one sector at a time.
OLD_ENRICO_2: The account is open in your name. Spend it wisely: every day of a contract costs money.
The mines can pay for the war once they are in friendly hands.
RIS_REPORT: Enemy patrols are thin near the coast and heavy around the capital. Expect resistance to stiffen as you advance.
OLD_ENRICO_3: The laptop links you to the hiring sites and your bank. Use it often.
Write back when your team has landed. We are counting on you.
